mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations and increase liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 350000 signal weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 350000, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity for equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting immediate supply-side economic weakness and reduced corporate output capacity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 350,000 signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 350000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor and housing markets, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000 and UNRATE > 5.0, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5%), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to strong economic growth, corporate earnings momentum, and sustained consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
